channel.title: Manuel Mendoza Hurtado — Publications
channel.description: Manuel Mendoza Hurtado is a university lecturer and PhD-qualified researcher specialising in human mobility, geospatial machine learning and multi-label learning.

item.title: Distance metrics for multi-label urban function and density classification from mobile phone data: A Milan benchmark
item.description: A Milan benchmark comparing distance metrics for multi-label classification of urban function and density from mobile phone activity.

item.title: A Comparative Analysis of Distance Metrics for Multilabel Land-Use Classification Using Mobile Phone Data in Trento
item.description: A comparison of distance metrics for multilabel land-use classification from mobile network activity in Trentino, Italy.

item.title: MAPLID: a new multi-label approach for place identification using data supplied by mobile network operators
item.description: A supervised multi-label framework that identifies concurrent urban functions from mobile-network activity and generalises across Milan and Trento.

item.title: Sensing labour mobility flows of cross-border urban regions using machine learning and geolocated social network data
item.description: A transferable machine-learning framework for detecting cross-border commuting from geolocated social-media traces across three European regions.

item.title: False flag: An evolutionary false labeling approach for multilabel classification
item.description: An evolutionary approach that deliberately modifies training labels to improve multi-label classification across diverse datasets and models.

item.title: A supervised approach for land use identification in Trento using mobile phone data as an alternative to unsupervised clustering techniques
item.description: Supervised land-use classification from call detail records in an alpine setting, testing generalisation beyond dense metropolitan areas.

item.title: SAMPLID: A new supervised approach for meaningful place identification using call detail records as an alternative to classical unsupervised clustering techniques
item.description: A supervised alternative to classical clustering for identifying meaningful places from call detail records.

item.title: Local-based k values for multi-label k-nearest neighbors rule
item.description: A locally adaptive method that selects a different neighbourhood size for each prototype in multi-label k-nearest-neighbour learning.

item.title: ML-proxkNN: Interpretable multi-label urban mapping from gridded mobile-network activity
item.description: A multi-label urban mapping method that uses grid adjacency during training to choose local neighbourhood sizes, evaluated on mobile-network data from Milan and Trento.
